text: Restaurant: Artisan Harvest Bowls. Dish: Truffle Quinoa & Avocado Power Bowl. Price: $16.50. Category: Bowls. Dietary: Vegan, Gluten-Free, High-Protein, Nut-Free. Nutrition: 540 kcal, 19g protein. Made with organic tri-color quinoa, cold-pressed white truffle vinaigrette, Hass avocado, heirloom tomatoes, roasted pumpkin seeds, and wild baby arugula.

Restaurant: Artisan Harvest Bowls. Dish: Citrus Miso Salmon Harvest Bowl. Price: $21.00. Category: Bowls. Dietary: Gluten-Free, High-Protein, Dairy-Free. Nutrition: 680 kcal, 42g protein. Contains fish, soy, sesame. Wild Alaskan grilled salmon filet with citrus miso glaze, forbidden black rice, edamame, and daikon.

Restaurant: Artisan Harvest Bowls. Dish: Crispy Tempeh Superfood Salad. Price: $15.25. Dietary: Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, High-Protein. Nutrition: 490 kcal, 24g protein. Organic maple-smoked tempeh, massaged dinosaur kale, shredded purple cabbage, hemp hearts, and green goddess avocado-tahini dressing.

Restaurant: Tokyo Craft Ramen & Yakitori. Dish: Rich 24-Hour Tonkotsu Deluxe Ramen. Price: $19.50. Category: Entrees. Dietary: High-Protein. Contains wheat, soy, egg, pork. Simmered Berkshire pork bone broth, springy wheat noodles, slow-braised chashu pork belly, ajitsuke tamago egg, and black garlic oil.

Restaurant: Tokyo Craft Ramen & Yakitori. Dish: Creamy Sesame Spicy Vegan Ramen. Price: $18.00. Category: Entrees. Dietary: Vegan, Vegetarian, Dairy-Free. Rich roasted oat and sesame broth, spicy chili oil, glazed king oyster mushrooms, pak choi, sweet corn, and scallions.

Restaurant: Verde Kitchen Plant Bar. Dish: Smoked Jackfruit Carnitas Bowl. Price: $15.75. Dietary: Vegan, Gluten-Free, Low-Carb, Dairy-Free. Nutrition: 420 kcal, 16g protein. Slow-braised spiced green jackfruit, organic black beans, charred street corn, pico de gallo, cilantro-lime cauli-rice, and chipotle crema.

Restaurant: Verde Kitchen Plant Bar. Dish: Keto Cauliflower Falafel Wrap. Price: $14.50. Dietary: Vegan, Keto, Gluten-Free, Low-Carb, Dairy-Free. Almond-flour wrap packed with golden herb-baked cauliflower falafels, cucumber ribbons, pickled pink turnips, and lemon garlic coconut-yogurt tzatziki.

Restaurant: Napoli Antica Wood-Fired Pizza. Dish: Gluten-Free Wild Forest Mushroom Pizza. Price: $21.50. Dietary: Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free. Crisp cauliflower and cassava crust, roasted chanterelles and cremini, vegan cashew truffle ricotta, and fresh thyme sprigs.
